summary: Backend end-to-end test for Localer. All 13 pytest tests passed (health, nearby all+filtered categories, geocode, register/duplicate, login success/fail, me, settings zh, favorites CRUD + dedup, AI ask EN & ZH, AI translate with cache).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 602 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting into routers (auth, favorites, nearby, ai) + providers module for maintainability.

/api/geocode and provider helpers swallow exceptions and return empty list silently — fine for UX but no retry/backoff on upstream (Wikipedia/Nominatim) failures. Consider short retry on transient 5xx.

AI endpoints raise 502 on exception which is correct, but no rate-limit guard on /api/ai/ask or /api/ai/translate — potential cost abuse without auth requirement (both endpoints are currently unauthenticated).
CORS allow_origins falls back to '*' with allow_credentials=True — browsers will reject credentials with wildcard; set an explicit origin in production.
Favorites GET uses sort('saved_at', -1).to_list(500) — no pagination; acceptable for MVP.
test_credentials: Fresh user registered per test session: tester+localer+<nonce>@example.com / pass1234 (not persisted across runs).
seed_data_creation: None persisted beyond per-run registered test user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. If frontend testing is next, note: /api/ai/ask and /api/ai/translate are unauthenticated and can be hit without a token. Nearby for Paris (48.8566, 2.3522) returns all 5 categories reliably; use for seed/sample data in UI tests.
